name: HarmonyOS Dev Agent
description: An ArkTS/ArkUI development agent that edits source through workspace tools and verifies through the HarmonyOS Dev Runtime.

capabilities.title: Understand HarmonyOS project
capabilities.description: Detect the HarmonyOS workspace, bundle, module, ability, target SDK, signing status, and likely ArkUI source files.

capabilities.title: Revise HarmonyOS UI
capabilities.description: Make scoped ArkTS/ArkUI source edits from user intent and selected preview context.

capabilities.title: Build, install, and verify
capabilities.description: Build the HarmonyOS project, install and launch when a target is available, then capture screenshot and hierarchy evidence.

capabilities.title: Diagnose HarmonyOS failure
capabilities.description: Use redacted runtime diagnostics, build logs, HDC target state, and project source to explain and repair failures.

permissions.summary: Uses configured AI providers through Sparo OS.
Reads and edits HarmonyOS project files through declared workspace tools.
Uses scoped workspace commands and delegates HarmonyOS toolchain operations to the runtime bridge.
